2008 BMW Z4 M Coupe - Sepang Bronze - Final Production Year - Enthusiast Collector Owned

One of BMW M's most distinctive creations, the E86 Z4 M Coupe was produced in exceptionally limited numbers, with just 4,581 examples manufactured worldwide between 2006 and 2008.

Finished in the seldom-seen Sepang Bronze Metallic, complemented by a beige leather interior with elegant wood trim, this final-year example has been privately owned and cherished by an enthusiast collector since 2018. Now reluctantly offered for sale after eight years of ownership.

What makes the Z4 M Coupe particularly special is its combination of the legendary S54 naturally aspirated engine, M3-derived mechanical components and an unusually intimate driving position. Seated low and far back towards the rear axle, looking down the long bonnet, the driver experiences an almost slingshot-like sensation as the car rotates through corners.

Unlike the more accommodating E46 M3, the Z4 M Coupe was designed as an uncompromising two-seat driver's car, with a short wheelbase, purposeful proportions and a level of mechanical engagement rarely found in modern performance vehicles.

THE LEGENDARY S54 ENGINE

- 3.2-litre naturally aspirated S54 inline six-cylinder, shared with the E46 M3
- 252kW of power at 7,900rpm and 365Nm of torque
- Six individual throttle bodies, one for each cylinder, delivering exceptional throttle response
- BMW M Double VANOS variable valve timing
- High 11.5:1 compression ratio
- 8,000rpm engine redline
- Distinctive induction sound and high-revving character
- 0-100km/h in just 5.0 seconds
- Close-ratio six-speed manual transmission

BMW M CHASSIS AND DRIVER ENGAGEMENT

- M Variable Differential Lock, using technology shared with the E46 M3
- High-performance compound braking system derived from the E46 M3 CSL
- Hydraulic power-assisted steering, rather than the electric steering fitted to regular Z4 models
- M-specific suspension with performance-oriented chassis tuning
- Rear-wheel drive with near-perfect weight distribution
- Low, rearward driving position for a direct connection with the chassis
- Short wheelbase and wide rear track
- 18-inch BMW M alloy wheels
- Quad exhaust outlets
- Distinctive double-bubble coupe roof and sculpted rear guards

THIS PARTICULAR EXAMPLE

- Final production year - 2008
- Rare Sepang Bronze Metallic exterior
- Beige leather interior with wood trim
- Heated front sports seats
- Privately owned by an enthusiast collector since 2018
- Cherished throughout eight years of ownership
- Reluctantly offered for sale
- One of only 4,581 Z4 M Coupes produced worldwide

1997 Ferrari 456 GT - One of Only 141 RHD Manuals - Gated 6-Speed - Naturally Aspirated V12 - Extensive Service History - Collector owned since 2020.


One of just 141 factory right-hand-drive manual examples produced worldwide, this 1997 Ferrari 456 GT represents a particularly exclusive chapter of Ferrari's V12 grand touring history.

Finished in metallic blue over an Ivory leather interior, this example has travelled just over 37,000 km and is accompanied by its original service books, document wallet, maintenance records and two keys.

Of the approximately 1,548 original 456 GTs produced with the six-speed manual transmission, only 141 were built in right-hand drive. The combination of Ferrari's iconic open-gated manual gearbox, naturally aspirated V12 and beautifully understated Pininfarina design makes this a particularly compelling car for the Ferrari enthusiast.

THE LEGENDARY FERRARI V12

- 5.5-litre naturally aspirated F116 V12 engine
- 325kW of power and 550Nm of torque
- 65-degree V12 architecture with 48 valves
- Dry-sump lubrication
- 0-100km/h in approximately 5.2 seconds
- Factory-rated top speed exceeding 300km/h
- Traditional front-engined Ferrari V12 configuration

THE GATED MANUAL AND TRANSAXLE

- Iconic Ferrari six-speed open-gated manual transmission
- One of only 141 factory RHD manual examples
- Rear-mounted transaxle incorporating the gearbox and differential
- Near 50:50 weight distribution
- Rear-wheel drive
- Independent double-wishbone suspension
- Electronically adjustable suspension damping
- Self-levelling rear suspension
- ZF Servotronic speed-sensitive steering

1997 Jaguar XJR - Supercharged Straight Six - Carnival Red Mica - Highly Collectable British Classic

Finished in the beautiful and distinctive Carnival Red Mica, complemented by an Oatmeal leather interior and rich burlwood woodgrain trim, this 1997 Jaguar XJR represents one of the most desirable generations of Jaguar's performance saloons.

The X300 XJR was Jaguar's first supercharged production saloon, combining traditional British craftsmanship with genuine sports sedan performance. Its timeless four-headlight design, elegant proportions and understated sporting character have earned it a special place among Jaguar enthusiasts and collectors.

The 1997 model represents the final year of the supercharged straight-six XJR before Jaguar transitioned to V8 power. At its heart is the renowned 4.0-litre AJ16 engine, enhanced by an Eaton supercharger producing 240kW and 512Nm of torque.
